purpose: Teach: 美学/うかがい/異物/恥ずかしながら/相まって/のけ/汚し/勝た

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、創業者の美学を継承しろ
lines.en: We must inherit the founder's vision for what this company stands for.
lines.style: Measured and authoritative. Deliberate pace on each phrase. The weight of legacy in his voice. Not harsh — the quiet gravity of someone passing judgment on principle.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。お得意様のお話、うかがい中です
lines.en: Yes. I've been speaking with our key accounts about their concerns.
lines.style: Respectful, slightly formal register. Steady delivery without apology. He's reporting clearly — showing he's listened and is tracking the situation.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 製品に異物混入はあってはならない
lines.en: Foreign material in our products is unacceptable. It cannot happen again.
lines.style: Clipped, precise. Each sentence a separate statement of fact. Cold clarity — not angry, but immovable. No room for negotiation in his tone.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 恥ずかしながら、当社、対応遅れがありました
lines.en: I'm aware our response was slower than it should have been. We fell short there.
lines.style: Quiet acknowledgment of failure. He's not defensive — owning it directly. Slight drop at the end, like accepting the weight of it without excusing himself.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社の不調と市場混乱が相まっての苦境だ
lines.en: We're caught between our own operational issues and the wider market turmoil. Both are hitting us hard right now.
lines.style: Analytical, almost clinical. He's laying out the facts as he sees them — not complaining, but being honest about the squeeze. Steady delivery, like explaining a diagnosis.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員、出張のけ口に休暇を取らせます
lines.en: Understood. We're giving staff time off after their travel assignments so they can reset.
lines.style: Action-focused, professional. He's showing forward movement — concrete decisions being made. Calm and capable, not scrambling.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社のブランドを汚し続ける広告は撤退しろ
lines.en: Any advertising that damages our brand reputation needs to be pulled. Immediately.
lines.style: Sharp, direct command. Weight lands on 'pulled.' He's not asking — this is a line drawn. Controlled intensity, the voice of someone who has made a decision.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。競合に勝たねば未来はない、と社員、心得ております
lines.en: Yes. The team understands — we can't move forward without winning against the competition. There is no future if we don't.
lines.style: Firm conviction underlying the words. He's speaking something he knows the staff has taken to heart. Slightly heavier on the stakes — he believes this. Closing statement carries weight.
